clock.authority: PC controller wall clock plus board monotonic uptime

protocol.absolute_event_time: Use controller timestamps captured before and after each formal board run.
protocol.elapsed_time: Use board CLOCK_MONOTONIC or /proc/uptime-derived timestamps; do not derive durations from board wall time.
protocol.board_wall_time: Advisory only. Set from the controller before a formal run and record it with board uptime.
protocol.receipt_requirement: Persist controller before/after timestamps and board uptime start/end in every formal-run receipt.

network_daemon.reason: Configured public NTP pools are unreachable from the board because DNS/direct UDP is unavailable; the HTTP proxy cannot transport NTP.
network_daemon.decision: Keep the already-installed chrony instead of replacing it with systemd-timesyncd; both would require direct NTP reachability. Chrony is not treated as the current clock authority.

perf.compatibility_note: Ubuntu's perf userspace is from the 5.15 tools package and is used against the custom 6.1.99 kernel. The P0-required generic cycles event works; event-specific support remains subject to each later preregistration.

network_install_path.method: Temporary SSH reverse tunnel from board 127.0.0.1:17888 to the PC HTTP proxy at 127.0.0.1:7888

changes: Set the board system clock from the PC controller.
Wrote the corrected system clock to the hardware RTC.
Installed only the Ubuntu perf userspace dependencies; no kernel upgrade was performed.
Created /home/orangepi/edgeforge_ope_r1/bin/perf as a workspace-local symlink to the installed perf binary.
negative_statement: No driver, device tree, kernel, RKLLM/RKNPU shared library, frozen artifact, model artifact, or governor value was modified. No formal performance measurement was run in this P0 completion step.
